Commentary.Commentary: Time for the chase! The Zimbabwe openers, Regis Chakabva and Tarisai Musakanda are the openers. Mustafizur Rahman to open the bowling.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Zimbabwe opted to bowl first but things didn't go as planned as they failed to break the opening stand. They only managed to take two wickets and their fielding wasn't the best as they dropped a couple of catches. The bowlers didn't hit the good areas and now they have a big task in their hands. Zimbabwe have the momentum but they have not been great in this format recently. Zimbabwe need a good start and need someone to anchor the innings to have a chance. Who do you think will start the series with a win? We will find out soon. Join us back for the chase after the break.

Bangladesh will be slightly disappointed as they had a big chance to post a huge score but no one changed their gears and eventually played a cautious innings before giving away their wickets. The top 4 scored more than fifty runs but didn't go full-fledged at any point. The pitch seemed to be a flat one but the approach from the visiting team was to control the innings. It might be just enough with a skillful bowling department that Bangladesh possess.

So, Bangladesh have breached the 300 mark but going in the break with so many wickets in hand. Bangladesh could have scored a bit more. Zimbabwe will not be that disappointed as they will back their batters to chase this down.
Two to end this innings! A full one on off, it is driven through covers for two. BANGLADESH END WITH 303/2!
A full toss outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
Two more! On middle, a full toss, it is hit down to long on for two.
FOUR! Top edge and a boundary! Shorter and outside off, Rahim looks to pull, this goes off the top edge and down to the third man fence.
Fuller and on off, Rahim strokes it to covers.
Gets away with one there! A full toss on the pads, with fine leg up in the ring. Mahmudullah looks to flick but it goes straight to the man at short fine leg.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
FOUR! Thumped down the ground! Fuller and on middle, this is hammered over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Fuller and on off, this is jammed out to covers for one.
A slower one outside off, Rahim moves across and leaves it alone thinking it is a wide, not given.
A yorker outside off, this is jammed through point for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Angled into the pads, Rahim works it through square leg for one.

Was that a chance? Maybe! A short one and around off, Mahmudullah looks to pull, this goes off the top edge towards short third man. The fielder there dives forward but does not get to the ball. He spills it. A single in the end.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Mahmudullah looks to pull but misses.
This is a brilliant over so far! On middle, fuller, this is worked back past the bowler but it hits the stumps at the other end.
A yorker on middle, this is jammed down to long on for one.
Outside off, on a length. Rahim looks to go over covers but misses.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Shorter and outside off, Rahim looks to cut but misses.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided through point for one.
FOUR! Pulled away! Shorter in length and on the body, this is pulled behind square on the leg side and this one races away to the fence.
FOUR! Two boundaries to end the over and the last two balls spoils it compoletely! Fuller and outside off, this is hit through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Poor ball and put away! Short and wide outside off, this is guided past point and this one races away to the fence.
Mahmudullah comes to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Big wicket at the moment as Anamul Haque was well set and was looking dangerous. This is full and on middle, he looks to go over mid on but does not get the distance. He holes out to Tarisai Musakanda the fielder at long on who takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Tarisai Musakanda b Victor Nyauchi

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, shorter, this is guided towards point for one.
Dots are gold dust! A yorker on middle, Rahim looks to whip it out but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Another one full and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one more.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Slower one on leg. It is pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Wide! Again this is down the leg side on the shorter side. Rahim looks to pull but misses.
Wide! Tries a slower one but spills it down the leg side. Left alone.
Short of a length and around off. Rahim looks to play at it but misses.

DROPPED! Wesley Madhevere drops a dolly!  Shorter and outside off. Haque slashes at it and the ball flies to deep point where Wesley Madhevere doesn't move an inch and takes it at a good height but makes a mess of it.
On a length and outside off. Rahim chops it to the right of the keeper who gets a hand to it and keeps it down to one.
FOUR MORE! Shorter again, outside off. Rahim slashes it through point for four more.
FOUR! Boundaries coming easily now! Short in length and around off. Rahim looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge and it flies over the keeper for four.
Too full and on middle. Haque helps it to fine leg for a brace.
SIX! Poor delivery! A slower bouncer on middle. It sits nicely for Haque who pulls it all the way over deep square leg for a biggie.
This one climbs on the body. Rahim turns it to square leg for a single.
Another single as this is flicked to deep mid-wicket.
Follows Haque on the leg side with a full ball. Haque flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Good start to the over! Short in length and on middle. Haque pulls it and fetches a boundary at deep square leg.
Fuller and on middle. Haque flicks it through square leg for a single. 6 runs off the over.
FOUR! Cheeky again! Short of a length and outside off. Haque gets low and upper cuts it over backward point for a boundary.
Fuller and on off, driven straight to mid off.
Shorter and this is pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
A wild swing and a miss! Length ball, outside off. Rahim comes down the track and looks to heave but misses.
Length and on off. Rahim blocks it out.
A single to end the over as Rahim tucks it to square leg.
FOUR! Cheeky! Shorter, quicker and outside off. Rahim steps across and scoops it over the keeper for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for one more.
A loopy ball on off. Haque defends it to mid off.
On middle. Blocked out.
Flatter and outside off. Rahim dabs it past short third man for a single. Another run was available but Rahim slips as he tries turn around.
Full and on off. Kept out.
SIX! What a way to get to fifty! Fuller ball on off. Haque comes down the track and smashes it to long on for a biggie. He needs to stay till the end now.
Tossed up on middle. Rahim eases it to long on for a single.
A loopy ball, outside off. Rahim looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Fuller and outside off, driven to deep cover for one more.
Too full and outside off. Rahim carves it to point who lets it through his hands for a single.
A huge appeal for LBW but not given! That looked tight! Tossed up, angling around middle and leg. Haque looks to work on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. Might be just missing leg.
Flatter and on middle. Rahim works it to long on for a single.
Shorter and on off, quicker and Rahim chops it to point.
Fuller and on the pads, forced to deep square leg for a single.
On middle. Blocked out.
On a length and outside off. Rahim dabs it to short third man for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Rahim slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
On a length and on middle. Haque plays it around the corner to mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, nudged wide of mid-wicket for one more.
Length and around middle and leg. Rahim tickles it to fine leg for a brace.
On a length and on middle. Haque whacks it aerially and to deep backward square leg. There was a man standing but he chose to collect on a bounce. A single.
Short of a length and outside off. Rahim steers it through point for a single.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! 200 up as well! Flatter and outside off. Haque dabs it past short third man, fine enough to race into the fence.
On the pads, whipped to square leg for a single.
Too full and on middle. Haque flicks it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Another single as Rahim eases it to long on.
Flatter and on middle. Haque nudges it to long on for a single.
Tossed up around off. Blocked out.
On the pads, Haque looks to flick but misses, it hits the pad and rolls on the leg side for one. Leg bye.
Another one on the pads, this is flicked through mid-wicket for another one.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Around off, this is guided to point.
Around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, defended.
On middle, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
A single now as this is eased down to long on.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
On middle, this is clipped to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Squeezed past point! Haque dealing in boundaries now! Outside off, fuller, this is jammed past point and it races away to the fence.
Shorter and around off, this is guided through point for one.
SIX! BANG! Over the fence! Short and on middle, Haque pulls it high and over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Fortunate boundary! Outside off, Haque slashes at it, it goes off the inside edge down to the fine leg fence.
On off, this is guided to point.

NOT OUT! Hauqe is in! Around middle, he looks to flick but it hits the pad and goes towards point. Haque wants a run but is sent back. The fielder hits the stumps at the keeper's end. It is taken upstairs but replays show that the batter is in.
Outside off, this is driven through covers for one.
On off, defended.
On middle, Haque works it to mid-wicket.
Shorter and on off, Haque pushes it to covers.
A single as this hit down to long on.
On the stumps, blocked.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

Halt in play! Litton Das is on the ground. Might be some hamstring issue. The physio is out and he needs some assistance. It is time for drinks as well. Bangladesh have 9 wickets in hand and a score of 300 is possible from here on but someone has to play a quick cameo. The live visuals show Das has been stretched out and the injury looks serious. Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.
Ouch! Litton Das is looking in some discomfort and is unable to continue. A blow to the batting team as Litton Das is retired hurt.
On middle, this is nudged around the corner for one.
Another one on the stumps, this is kept out well.
FOUR! The last one was forced, this was timed! On middle, this is timed past the bowler and into the long on fence.
SIX! All the way! Fuller and on off, Das lofts it down the ground and this clears the long off fence.
Shorter and outside off, Das looks to pull but misses.
A single! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Outside off, left alone.
On the stumps, this is worked through mid-wicket for one more.
Another run as this is worked through mid-wicket.
On middle, this is played to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is flicked through square leg for one.
Another single as this is nudged on the leg side.
On middle, this is nudged through square leg for one.
FOUR! Pulled again! On the shorter side, this is hit through square leg for a boundary.
Shorter in length and this is pulled down to fine leg for one.
A sharp bumper, Haque evades it.
Good length again, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Two more! Fuller and outside off, this is driven through covers for two.
On middle. Das lunges and blocks. 14 runs off the over. Just the over Bangladesh needed to make a shift.
FOUR! That is third in a row! Das changing the gears after his fifty! Flatter and outside off. Das punches it hard and through point for a boundary.
FOUR! Two in a row! Wellington Masakadza serves it full and on middle. Das stays back and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! Well played! Floats one full and on middle. Das whips it to deep square leg, it beats the diving fielder as well for four.
Around off, pushed to long off for a single.
Fifty for Das! His 7th in ODI cricket! Full and on middle, Litton Das flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. He will hope to make the most of the opportunity.
A maiden to start the second spell! On a length and outside off. Haque lets it go.
Fuller and on off. Haque softly plays it to mid off.
Now this one goes away with the angle. Haque leaves it alone.
Lovely delivery! On a length and outside off, nips in. Haque looks to defend away from the body and gets beaten on the inside edge.
Pitched up, outside off. Haque dabs it to backward point.
On a length and outside off.  Haque shoulders arms to it.
On middle, another single as Haque drills it to long on.
A loopy ball on middle, Das eases it to long on for one.
Shorter and outside off, it skids through. Haque looks to defend but splices it to backward point for a single.
Tossed up on middle, nudged to the right of mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter and on middle, angling on. Das gets low and pulls it to short fine leg.
Tossed up on off. Defended out.
On off, played to point for a single.
Full and on off, pushed to covers.
Too full and slanting on middlle, played back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle, flicked to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Sees some width outside off. and Haque goes on the back foot quickly to hit it through point for a boundary.
Angles a full ball, outside off, pushed to the right of point.
Flatter and on middle. Das nudges it straight to mid-wicket.
Length ball, outside off, pushed through point for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Finally Zimbabwe get the breakthrough and Tamim Iqbal goes after a well-made fifty! Raza serves a short ball, outside off. It is there to be pull and Iqbal goes with the shot. He mistimes and the top edge flies to short third man where Innocent Kaia takes it with ease. Zimbabwe will look to build on this.
Commentary.Howout: c Innocent Kaia b Sikandar Raza

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, fuller and it is eased down to mid on for a single.
Bye! Shorter and outside off. Iqbal tries to dab it away but misses. The keeper gets some gloves on it and the deflection goes past him for a bye.
Tossed up on middle, flicked to square leg for a single.
FOUR! The last ball spoils the over! A glorious shot! Fuller and outside off, this is hammered through covers.
The reverse sweep is out but it is hit to point.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
That has demolished the stumps at the other end! On middle, this is thumped down the ground but the stumps at the other end saves a boundary. A single in the end.
On off, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Another one on the stumps, blocked.
On middle, kept out.
FOUR! 8000 ODI RUNS FOR TAMIM! First player to do so for Bangladesh! A deft touch to get there! Shorter and outside off, this is guided through short third man for a boundary.
Just the one now as this is nudged on the leg side.
FOUR! Thumped away! Short and on the body, this is pulled through square leg for a boundary.
On middle, this is nudged to square leg.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On middle, this is nudged towards mid-wicket for one.
Two more! Fifty for Tamim! The skipper leading from the front. A really good innings from him so far. He would want to make it big now. On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side for two.
Another one on the stumps, kept out.
On middle, defended.
On middle, this is worked down to long on.
Tossed up outside off, this is driven but to covers.
Another one on the stumps, kept out.
On off, blocked.
On middle, this is worked to square leg.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed to cover.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided towards short third man for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid on.
Another one on the stumps, blocked well.
On off, fired. Defended.
A loud shout but turned down! On the pads, Tamim looks to play the paddle sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. Pitched outside leg.
Fuller and on off, this is hit down to long on for one.
Slight halt! Ryan Burl is feeling some pain near his left side, over the hips and it is not looking good. The physio is out and Ryan Burl is walking off the field in pain.
Two more! Outside off, this is hit through covers for two.
Almost! On the pads, Iqbal looks to flick but misses, it hits the padl and rolls just pas the leg pole.
Another one on off, Iqbal defends it solidly.
WIDE! Way too short, evaded easily.
Fuller and on off, Iqbal pushes it to mid off.
Fuller and on off, Tamim pushes it to mid off.
On middle, Tamim nudges it to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is clipped through square leg for one.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over! Well played! Drops it touch short and outside off. Iqbal punches off the back foot, through covers and it races into the fence.
Wide! Way down the leg side. Iqbal shoulders arms to it.
On middle. Defended.
Floated ball, full and around leg. Iqbal looks for a wild sweep but misses.
Slanting on middle, on a fuller length and it is hit to mid-wicket.
Wide! A leggie but this is down the leg side. Iqbal fails to flick it away.
Flighted delivery, full and on middle. Iqbal prods and blocks it.
Flatter ball, around off. Iqbal steps down and defends it.
On the pads, whipped to deep square leg for one more.
Too full and on middle, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Around middle and leg. Iqbal turns it to deep square leg for a single.
On middle. Iqbal solidly blocks it out.
This is full and outside off. Iqbal is early as he looks to drive and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On a length and on middle. Iqbal steps across and defends it.
Drinks! Bangladesh have done well till now but it's time for them to change the gears and look for a bigger score. They are unhurt and should take a bit of risk and try to push the run rate up.
Floated full and outside off, drilled down to long on for a single. Bangladesh are cruising along nicely here.
A single as Das pushes this full ball through covers.
Good stop at mid-wicket! Full and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Pushed through quicker and down the leg side. Iqbal sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on middle, pushed to mid on.
Tossed up on off, angling in. Blocked out.
Around off. Das drops it straight to the man at covers.
On a length and outside off. Das has a poke at it but misses.
Fuller and outside off. Iqbal slices it through point for a single.
Length and on middle, Iqbal wrists it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Any width and the Bangladeshi batters are not missing it! This one is on a length and outside off. Iqbal cuts it through point for four.
Serves one on middle, it is worked to square leg for a run.
Shorter and on off, turning in. Iqbal works it to point.
Tossed up on middle. Iqbal reverse sweeps but straight to short third man.
On middle, kept out.
Fuller and on middle. Iqbal nudges it to mid-wicket. The fielder dives and makes a good stop. Das wants a single but some good fielding does not allow it.
Slightly short and outside off, Das hits it through point for one more.
FOUR! Not good enough from Wellington Masakadza! Short, width and Das cuts it away through point for a boundary
On a length and on off. Iqbal taps it to covers for no run.
Short in length and outside off. Left alone.
Length ball, around middle, bunted to square leg for one more.
Targets the middle pole, it is flicked to deep square leg for one.
This is full and outside off. Iqbal leans and pushes it to mid off.
Length ball, outside off. Das tries to push but edges it away to third man for a single.
Flatter and outside off. Das slaps it to point who fumbles to stop and gives away a single.
Around off, fuller. Blocked out.
On the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for one more.
IN THE AIR AND FALLS SAFE! Flights one full and on middle. Das tries to slog-sweep it but gets a top edge and it falls in front of the running deep square leg fielder. A single.
Wellington Masakadza is not learning his lessons! he keeps bowling shot one. Iqbal pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
On middle, nudged to square leg.
Wide! Serves this one way down the leg side. Iqbal leaves it alone for a wide.
Length and on off, it is worked to covers. Just a run then off the over.
Consistency from Jongwe! He serves it on the pads. Das closes the bat face early and the leading edge falls towards point.
Again served on the pads, nudged straight to mid-wicket.
Das is not happy with the shot! This is straight on the pads. Das just eases it to mid on. Could have hit away for some runs.
Fuller ball, outside off. Das keeps it out.
Bowls this one on the hips, tucked to fine leg for one.
Serves it full and outside off. Das leans and pushes it to point.
Much better! Tossed up on middle. Blocked on the front foot.
Goes full now, around middle. Das prods to defend.
Wellington Masakadza keeps bowling short ball. Das pulls it to the right of mid-wicket.
FOUR! Again on the shorter side. This time Das punches it through point, in the gap for four.
Short ball to start with, outside off and extra bounce on offer. Das fails to play at it and the keeper fumbles a bit to collect.
Powerplay 2 time! Now, 4 fielders are allowed outside the circle till the 40th over. Also, Wellington Masakadza is into the attack.
A dot to end then! On middle, Iqbal defends it nicely.
Outside off, well wide. Left alone.
FOUR! Fifty up for Bangladesh! This is short and outside off, Iqbal stands tall and pushes it through covers for a boundary.
More of these please is what Zimbabwe's captain will be saying! Length and outside off, Tamim goes chasing after it but is beaten.
FOUR! Nice and fine! Another poor delivery from Victor Nyauchi! On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side and it races away to the fence.
Das walks across, this is on middle, he works it through square leg and gets to the other end.
A dot to end then! A good comeback by Richard Ngarava after going for a boundary on the very first ball. Just the 6 from the over but still a good one for the visitors. Outside off, left alone.
NIcely played! Length and outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
From around the wicket now, this is angled into the pads, Das works it to mid-wicket. Not sure if this is the right angle.
Quick run! On middle, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
Back of a length now and on off, defended.
FOUR! That is a wonderful shot. Not much wrong with the delivery! It is on a length and around off, Tamim drives it on the up and through covers for a boundary.

That is a beauty! Victor Nyauchi felt he had his man! This is on a length and around off, it lands and moves away. Das looks to defend but is beaten. An appeal but turned down. This is what Victor Nyauchi needs to bowl more. He has been very wayward.
Just outside off again, left alone.
FOUR RUNNING RUNS! Brilliant from Das and Tamim! On middle, this is clipped through mid-wicket. The mid-wicket fielder gives it a chase. He manages to push it back in. However, the batters run four.
Better! This is just outside off, on a length. Left alone. He needs to be a lot more consistent with such balls.

Uppish but well wide of the fielder! On the pads, this is worked wide of square leg and down to fine leg for one. Victor Nyauchi needs to be more on the off pole. He is a little too straight at the moment.
WIDE! Gets away with one there! This is down the leg side. Tamim looks to flick but misses. Wided.
A quick run! On middle, Das works it towards mid on for a single.
That is a sharp bumper! Really well bowled! On middle and well-directed. Tamim ducks under it nicely.
Goes fuller this time and on middle, Das works it to mid on and takes one.
Really well bowled again! On middle, this one jags back in and also takes off after landing. Das defends it by taking one hand off the handle.
Quick run! On middle, Tamim works it towards mid on and takes one. He had to get bat on that, he played it with a closed face in front of middle.
Angled into middle, Iqbal works it to mid-wicket.
That is a beauty! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Tamim is beaten as he tries to defend.
On a length and on middle, jagging back in. Das gets hit on the pads as he tries to work it away. A stifled appeal follows but was going down.
On the pads, too straight and Iqbal clips it to deep square leg for easy three runs.
Hits the hard length, around off. Iqbal defends it on the deck.
Angles this one across, way outside off and Tamim leaves it alone.
Length and on off. Das punches it through covers for quick one.
On middle. Blocked out.
Five wides! Poor ball! Gets too much to swing this one, it is full and angling way down the leg side. Left alone and the keeper cannot do much to stop it. It races behind to the fence.
Outside off, Iqbal shoulders arms to it.

RIPPER! This one is an absolute ripper! A length ball, around off and nips back in sharply, there is extra bounce as well. Iqbal is squared up as he tries to defend and the ball goes over middle pole. That was an effort ball.
Sprays one on the pads. Das nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Length and around off. Blocked to covers.
This time Das gets behind the line of the ball to block it out.
BEATEN! Gorgeous delivery! Angles across a length ball, outside off and nips back in a touch. Das is rooted in his crease as he tries to defend and gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a length and outside off. Iqbal chops it to point.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
This one nips back in from outside off. Iqbal has his stumps covered as he leaves it alone.
FOUR! Width given way outside off and Iqbal leans and drives it through covers for another boundary.
BEATEN! That is a beauty! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Tamim is beaten as he tries to defend.
Fuller and outside off, the tempter, wanting Tamim to drive but Tamim lets it be.
On the middle pole, it is defended. End of a very good over for Bangladesh.
FOUR! Pulled away! Shorter and on middle, Das stays back and hammers this pull over mid-wicket and into the fence. He is off the mark with a boundary too.
Back of a length and on off, blocked.

FOUR OVERTHROWS! Bonus runs for Bangladesh and this is not what Zimbabwe needed. The pressure was building and the pressure has been released! On middle, this is defended to mid on. They take off. The fielder gets to the ball, picks it up and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. No one backing up and it goes to the fence.
Back of a length and on off, defended.
Length and on off, Tamim pushes it to mid on.
Length again and on off, Das pushes it to covers. A maiden to begin then.
Outside off, gets this one to shape away. Left alone.
A loud appeal but the impact is outside off. Length and outside off, this one comes back in. Das looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pads.
Back of a length and on off, defended again.
Angled into the pads, Das works it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length and on the shorter side, defended.
Victor Nyauchi to bowl from the other end.

FOUR! Off the mark in style! The last ball also spoils the over a little! On the pads, Tamim works it fine on the leg side. Fine leg runs to his left but has no chance. A boundary to get things underway.
On middle, Tamim pushes it to mid on.
4 really good deliveries by Richard Ngarava! Length and on off, this time he gets the ball to jag back in. Tamim looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
That is well bowled! Well played too in the end! Length and on off, this one holds its line. Tamim looks to defend but seeing the movement, pulls his bat back.
Well bowled again! Slightly shorter in length and on middle, Tamim stands tall and defends it onto the off side.
On the money to begin with! Length and on off, Tamim defends.

We are all set for the action. It is time for the national anthems! Bangladesh will sing their first and then it will be Zimbabwe's turn. Done will all the pre-match proceedings. The players walk out to the middle. Tamim Iqbal and Litton Das are the openers for Bangladesh. Richard Ngarava to start with the ball. Here we go...
